source: Points and who may carry each item are from Warmaster Armies v2.26, p.88. Descriptions are from the Warmaster Revolution rulebook, Magic Items.

items.name: The Battle Banner
items.summary: +1 Attack to each stand. The banner can be lost when a stand is removed.
items.description: Each stand in the unit has +1 close combat Attack. Whenever a stand from the unit is removed, roll a D6. On a 1, 2, or 3 the banner is lost. Only one Battle Banner can be included in the army.

items.name: The Banner of Shielding
items.summary: +1 Armour. The banner can be lost when a stand is removed.
items.description: The unit's Armour is one better: 5+ becomes 4+, and so on. Whenever a stand from the unit is removed, roll a D6. On a 1, 2, or 3 the banner is lost. Only one Banner of Shielding can be included in the army.

items.name: The Banner of Fortitude
items.summary: +1 Hit. The banner can be lost when a stand is removed.
items.description: Each stand in the unit has +1 Hit. Whenever a stand from the unit is removed, roll a D6. On a 1, 2, or 3 the banner is lost. Only one Banner of Fortitude can be included in the army.

items.name: The Banner of Steadfastness
items.summary: Ignore one shooting hit after saves, each turn.
items.description: Each turn, one shooting hit inflicted on the unit after saves is ignored. This includes hits from spells in the Shooting phase. Whenever a stand from the unit is removed, roll a D6. On a 1, 2, or 3 the banner is lost. Only one Banner of Steadfastness can be included in the army.

items.name: The Banner of Fortune
items.summary: Once per game, re-roll all the unit's Attack dice in one Shooting or Combat roll.
items.description: Once per game, re-roll all of the unit's Attack dice in one Shooting or Combat roll, including bonus attacks from magic items or characters. Every dice must be rolled again, including dice that already scored hits. Only one Banner of Fortune can be included in the army.

items.name: Crown of Command
items.summary: General only. The first order each turn may be issued against an unmodified Command of 10. If it fails, the Crown is lost.
items.description: General only. The General's first order each turn may be issued against an unmodified Command of 10. No command penalties apply to that order. Later orders are given normally. If the first order fails, on an 11 or 12, the Crown stops working. Only one Crown of Command can be included in the army.

items.name: Helm of Dominion
items.summary: General only. +1 Command, to a maximum of 10, for one turn.
items.description: General only. The General's Command is increased by +1, to a maximum of 10. It works for one turn in the battle. Say at the start of the turn that it is being used. Only one Helm of Dominion can be included in the army.

items.name: Orb of Majesty
items.summary: General only. Once per game, re-roll one failed order as if Command were 8. Dark Elf and High Elf Generals cannot use it.
items.description: General only. Once in the game, disregard one failed Command test issued by the General and roll it again as if his Command were 8. The usual penalties apply, but the failed roll itself does not count as a penalty. If the re-roll succeeds, the General continues with his normal Command. Dark Elf and High Elf Generals cannot use the Orb. Only one Orb of Majesty can be included in the army.

items.name: Sceptre of Sovereignty
items.summary: General only. Ignore one Blunder. Dark Elf and High Elf Generals cannot use it.
items.description: General only. Ignore one blundered double 6 rolled for an order by the General or another character. If a subordinate blunders, you may see what the blunder is before deciding to use the Sceptre. If it is ignored, the order is passed and that character may continue issuing orders. Dark Elf and High Elf Generals cannot use the Sceptre. Only one Sceptre of Sovereignty can be included in the army.

items.name: Ring of Magic
items.summary: Wizard only. Once per game, cast one spell on a 2+. It cannot be combined with another casting bonus.
items.description: Wizard only. Once in the game, cast one spell on a roll of 2+. When it is used, it cannot be combined with any other item that gives a bonus to cast. Only one Ring of Magic can be included in the army.

items.name: Staff of Spellbinding
items.summary: Wizard or Runesmith. Spellbind an enemy Wizard who failed a spell, on a 4+. They then have -1 to cast.
items.description: Wizard or Dwarf Runesmith only. If an enemy Wizard fails to cast a spell, spellbind them on a 4+. A spellbound Wizard has -1 to cast. The Staff stops working once it has been used successfully, so only one enemy Wizard can be spellbound by it. Only one Staff of Spellbinding can be included in the army.

items.name: Scroll of Dispelling
items.summary: Wizard or Runesmith. Once per game, an enemy spell fails on a 2+.
items.description: Wizard or Dwarf Runesmith only. Once in the game, an enemy spell that has been successfully cast fails on a roll of 2+. A Runesmith may use the Scroll after a normal Dwarf anti-magic roll has failed. Only one Scroll of Dispelling can be included in the army.

items.name: Wand of Power
items.summary: Wizard only. Once per game, +1 to cast one spell. A roll of 1 still fails.
items.description: Wizard only. Once in the game, add +1 to the chance of a spell working. Decide to use the Wand before rolling. A spell still fails on a roll of 1. Only one Wand of Power can be included in the army.

items.name: Rod of Repetition
items.summary: Wizard only. Once per game, after a spell is successfully cast, immediately try to cast another.
items.description: Wizard only. Once in the game, if a spell rolls high enough to work, the Wizard may immediately try to cast another spell. It can be the same spell or a different one. It does not matter if the first spell was dispelled, so long as the required score was rolled. The second spell is rolled for in the usual way. Only one Rod of Repetition can be included in the army.

items.name: Sword of Destruction
items.summary: One enemy unit in contact must re-roll one successful Armour roll each combat round.
items.description: One enemy unit touching the unit with this sword must re-roll one successful Armour roll in each round of combat. Only one enemy unit is affected. Only one Sword of Destruction can be included in the army.

items.name: Sword of Fate
items.summary: Once per game, +1 Attack to one stand in the first round of the unit's first combat.
items.description: In the first round of the unit's first combat, add +1 Attack to one stand, in the same way as a character's Attack bonus. This is +1 Attack in total, not +1 to each stand, and it works only once in the game. Only one Sword of Fate can be included in the army.

items.name: Sword of Cleaving
items.summary: Re-roll one failed Attack dice each combat round.
items.description: Re-roll one unsuccessful Attack dice in each round of combat. Only one Sword of Cleaving can be included in the army.

items.name: Sword of Might
items.summary: +1 Attack to one stand in the Combat phase.
items.description: Add +1 Attack to one stand, in the same way as a character's Attack bonus. This is +1 Attack in total, not +1 to each stand. Only one Sword of Might can be included in the army.
